question: A/An ________ is an interface between the user and hardware.
solution:
The correct answer is __**operating system**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operating System**

 
 
• An **operating system (OS) **serves as an** interface between the computer user and the hardware**.
 
• **Operating System software **is responsible for controlling **computer hardware, managing software resources, and offering standard services for computer programs**.
 
• By utilising the **hardware drivers** as the interface between the two, it sits in between the applications you execute and the hardware. 
 
• For instance, when an application **wants to print something**, it defers to the OS to handle that operation.
 
• The following are some of the** key functions** that an operating system should perform:
 
 
• **Memory management,**
 
• Device management,
 
• **Processor management,**
 
• **Security,**
 
• **File management,**
 
• Coordination between other software and users**, **
 
• **Error detection tools,**
 
• and Job accounting.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Operating systems are present on a wide range of computing devices, including **supercomputers, web servers, mobile phones, and gaming consoles**.
 
• Some of the **most popular operating systems** include:
 
 
• Apple macOS
 
• Apple's iOS
 
• Microsoft Windows
 
• Linux
 
• UNIX
 
• Android
 
 
 
• With a market share of roughly **76.45%, Microsoft Windows** is the most popular operating system for **general-purpose personal computers**.
 
• In second place **(17.72%) is Apple Inc.'s macOS**, followed by all of the** Linux distributions in third (1.73%)**.
 
• In the year** 2020**, **Android's market share** in the mobile industry (which includes smartphones and tablets) is up to **72%**.
